_about: Human-entered approval lineage. Each chain step = one FDA approval event and the trial(s) the reviewer entered as its efficacy basis. tools/lineage_verify.py checks every entry against ClinicalTrials.gov and the cached Drugs@FDA label/review text; nothing here reaches the tree unless it is verified or explicitly shown as needs_review.

_fields.aliases: Extra trial identifiers not in the registry record (sponsor protocol IDs, acronyms). Matched whole-token in FDA text. Also fed into approval_anchor.py.
_fields.chain[].lead: Trial(s) the step is credited to. Must be named in a Label or Review at the step's approval event, outside postmarketing-requirement context.
_fields.chain[].co_basis: Other trials FDA used for the same approval. Verified the same way; shown beside the lead.
_fields.chain[].precursors: Earlier-phase trials that led to the lead trial. 'doc_supported' when the approval documents name them, else 'registry_only'.
_fields.chain[].approval.type: accelerated | regular, as entered. Verifier checks the approval letter for 21 CFR 314.510 / 601.41 (accelerated) wording.
_fields.entered_by: Who entered the step. Steps entered by Claude from FDA documents are marked so the user can confirm them.
_fields.intervention_names: Names the registry may use for the drug (code names). Registry gate requires one of them in the trial's interventions.
_fields.chain[].accept: Reason prefixes (as printed by lineage_verify.py) the reviewer has checked and accepted, e.g. 'NCT02005471: already named'. Status becomes verified_with_override.
